summary: The 0.2.0 baseline records all 36 declared cases per runtime, including the existing BehaviourTree.tick reactive workload at 1,000, 10,000 and 100,000 ticks. It combines exactly three sequential original hosted runs of the same clean source using the maintained combiner. Complete .NET and Node case/work-count sets match across all three runs; the combiner records median-of-medians, median-of-p95, min/max per-run median and CV. Runner class, image and toolchain match, while the CPU models vary within that hosted class and the timing spread is substantial. Use the recorded spread alongside medians for hosted-class regression comparisons; these measurements establish neither absolute performance nor savings. They measure the existing reactive tick kernel, not the optional halt-trace API overhead. The baseline and README retain run identities and source revision; raw archives remain outside Atlas. Source capture does not establish package publication, installation or current native acceptance.
title: Hosted reactive-tick baseline preserves work counts and measured spread
